capabilities: Visualize projects, problems, tasks, and pending inputs in a three-panel workbench
Capture and review pending inputs in an inbox with pending/processed states
Edit frontmatter fields directly on project and problem cards
Search and filter loaded notes with multi-select filters and archive toggles
Resize side columns and use drawers on narrow screens
extras: Includes a Node CLI context exporter (dist/cli/export-context.js) and a formal vault handoff installer requiring an explicit --apply flag with a readonly baseline; settings are stored per active configuration directory and updates preserve them.
problem: Obsidian notes have no structured, mobile-friendly view tying projects, problems, tasks, and unconfirmed inputs together.

relations.evidence: Tasks: TaskNotes-compatible status, priority, due, projects, and tags fields.

summary: Markdown-backed workbench that visualizes projects, problems, tasks, and pending inputs in a three-panel interface for planning and review.
